STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_05390_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_05390_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_05390 (y, clk, rst, x);
input x;
input clk;
input rst;
output reg y;

// State Encoding
parameter [1:0] ST_A = 2'b00;
parameter [1:0] ST_B = 2'b01;
parameter [1:0] ST_C = 2'b10;

reg [1:0] s_pr_state;
reg [1:0] s_nx_state;
reg s_y_out;

// State Transition
always @(posedge clk or posedge rst)
begin
    if (rst)
        s_pr_state <= ST_A;
    else
        s_pr_state <= s_nx_state;
end

// Next State Logic and Output Logic
always @(s_pr_state or x)
begin
    case (s_pr_state)
        ST_B: begin
            s_y_out = 1'b1;
            if (x) s_nx_state = ST_C;
            else s_nx_state = ST_A;
        end
        ST_C: begin
            s_y_out = 1'b0;
            if (!x) s_nx_state = ST_A;
            else s_nx_state = ST_C;
        end
        default: begin
            s_y_out = 1'b0;
            if (x) s_nx_state = ST_B;
            else s_nx_state = ST_A;
        end
    endcase
end

// Output Register Update
always @(posedge clk or posedge rst)
begin
    if (rst)
        y <= 1'b0;
    else
        y <= s_y_out;
end

endmodule
